tcm.title: TCM Constitution Assessment
tcm.subtitle: Based on the "TCM Constitution Classification and Determination" standard, identify your primary constitution from 9 types
tcm.questionnaireHeader: Please select based on your actual condition
tcm.pingheDesc: Yin-Yang in harmony, moderate body shape, rosy complexion, abundant energy. The most ideal constitution with low disease rate.
tcm.qixuDesc: Insufficient vital energy, easily fatigued, short of breath, spontaneous sweating, soft muscles, weak resistance to disease.
tcm.yangxuDesc: Insufficient yang energy, cold intolerance, cold limbs, prefers hot food, prone to diarrhea.
tcm.yinxuDesc: Insufficient yin fluid, dry mouth and throat, hot palms and soles, insomnia, dry stools.
tcm.tanshiDesc: Phlegm-damp accumulation, obesity, distended abdomen, oily skin, easy drowsiness.
tcm.shireDesc: Internal damp-heat, greasy face, acne, bitter/dry mouth, heavy body and fatigue.
tcm.xueyuDesc: Impaired blood flow, dull complexion, easy bleeding, fixed pain, dark purple lips.
tcm.qiyuDesc: Qi stagnation, depressed mood, vulnerability, chest and rib distension, sensation of foreign body in throat.
tcm.tebingDesc: Congenital imbalance, prone to allergies (drugs, food, pollen), asthma, eczema, hives.
tcm.q0: Do you often feel fatigued or lack energy?
tcm.q1: Are you easily cold, with cold hands and feet?
tcm.q2: Do you sweat easily (not due to hot weather)?
tcm.q4: Do you easily feel anxious or in low mood?
tcm.q5: Are you easily prone to colds or infections?
tcm.q6: How are your appetite and digestion?
tcm.q7: Are you prone to thirst or internal heat?
tcm.q8: Is your skin prone to allergies or rashes?
tcm.q9: Is your body type thin or overweight?
tcm.finishHint: Complete the questionnaire and click the button above to see your constitution type and personalized wellness plan

partner.applyDesc: Leave your email and context. We reply within 2 business days.
